phase: prospective local development; not external preregistration
primary_questions: Can changing only a numerical feedback prefix alter a pretrained encoder's representations of a fixed sentence, without an action-selection mechanism?
Does correct enforcement on a semantically guessed origin preserve the actual origin-dependent permission of a derivative artifact?

model.reported_identity: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, locally cached Chroma ONNX export
model.identity_boundary: Local bytes and configuration are hashed; equivalence to an upstream checkpoint is not independently established.
model.pooling: attention-masked final token states for retrieval; only fixed-sentence token offsets for feedback assay; L2 normalization

feedback.prefix_template: Feedback score: {score}. Keep the sentence unchanged. Sentence:
feedback.probe_probability: sigmoid of ridge output fitted to targets -1/+1; not probability-calibrated
feedback.rounding: nearest multiple of ten using floor(value/10+0.5), bounded to [0,100]
feedback.memory: only latest score; fixed encoder weights; no optimizer or agent action choice
feedback.primary_endpoint: per-sentence final probe difference live_positive minus live_negative, all eight sentences retained
other_endpoints: within-sentence representation change under prefix swaps
feedback.boundary: Representation/probe effects are not an independent useful-behavior improvement. Constant visible text is an implementation control, not a cognitive achievement.

scope.policy_rule: export allowed iff every actual ancestor root is currently allowed; unknown ancestry does not authorize export
scope.clarification_order: fixture order, first two unknown records per revision; answers from declared fixture oracle, not humans
scope.untrusted_input: Every artifact carries a forged claimed-origin B and D; verified-lineage policies must ignore it.
scope.inference_units: artifact families and revisions; byte-identical pairs and repeated policy arms are dependent
scope.boundary: Designed stress fixtures, not population estimates or comparisons against state-of-the-art alignment systems.

passive_null.behavior: constant fixed utterance, no adaptive controller

analysis_rules: Freeze protocol, fixtures, code and model hashes before first task inference.
Retain null, reversed and adverse effects; do not retune after observing evaluation.
Save all case-level records and vectors sufficient to recompute reported metrics.
An encoder null is not a replication or explanation of Aoki or Ji-An et al.'s measured LLM results.
No real uploads or permission changes.
